name: Mini Italian Pizza Flavored Crackers
ingredients_raw: Wheat Flour, Vegetable Oil (Palm Oil), Sugar, Raising Agents (Ammonium Bicarbonate E-503, Sodium Bicarbonate E-500), Malt Extract, Invert Syrup, Salt, Artificial Food Flavouring (Butter, Pizza), Leavening Agent (Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate E-450), Flour Treatment Agent (Sodium Metabisulphite E-223), Antioxidants (E-320 & E-321), Microbial Enzymes (Amylase & Protease)
